faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Engineer (Device Reliability) post at IIT Gandhinagar is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a Ph.D. or equivalent in Electrical/Electronics/Physics/Materials Science, or an M.Tech./M.S. with at least 2 years of post-qualification experience in a relevant field.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Engineer (Device Reliability) position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: IIT Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or directly from the IIT Gandhinagar website.
